name: ringly
description: Ringly — native cross-platform notifications for Claude Code with i18n (pt-BR / en-US)

language.title: Language (tip: run `ringly config` for a visual picker)
language.description: Type exactly: auto, pt-BR, or en-US. For a friendlier UI with arrow-key selection, run `ringly config` in your terminal.

events_notification.title: Notify on Notification events
events_notification.description: Toast when Claude requests permission or input. Toggle with Space.

events_stop.title: Notify on Stop events
events_stop.description: Toast when Claude finishes a response. Toggle with Space.

events_stopFailure.title: Notify on StopFailure events
events_stopFailure.description: Toast when an API error ends the session. Toggle with Space.

events_subagentStop.title: Notify on SubagentStop events
events_subagentStop.description: Toast when a subagent finishes. Toggle with Space.

sound.title: Play sound
sound.description: Play a sound with each notification. Toggle with Space.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Write detailed logs to %APPDATA%/ringly/Log (or the OS standard log dir). Toggle with Space.

check_updates.title: Check for updates automatically
check_updates.description: Once a day, check npm for a newer Ringly release and notify via toast. Toggle with Space.
